author: Codex critical design agent design91_deadline_walk
execution_scope: Mechanism design, primary-source reading and direct critical RTL reading only. No model, RTL edit, build or board run.
recommendation: Treat this as a concrete L-F admission/placement extension and a lower-complexity ablation. Root's overlapping-choice rank rule supersedes its independent-pool count rule when offers overlap. Do not promote source bypass, delayed fill, or a pin by themselves as a new algorithm.

candidate.name: Choice-capacity preservation with request-local translation delivery
candidate.new_action: At a successful source walk's fill point, choose an ordinary eligible victim that does not destroy the surviving FREE-hot output capacity required by already admitted, still-unbound COPY parents. If no such victim exists, run the usual READ permission checks directly on that walk result and return it to its original real request without installing it in the shared IOTLB. Optionally retain one result until a selected output's actual WRITE translation is consumed, then install at an expendable location. Normal output permissions and all data transfers remain necessary.
candidate.why_it_is_more_than_reordering: It may eliminate a later output walk by preventing a necessary source walk from changing the choice set. The source walk still occurs and completes; its result need not occupy shared cache storage. It changes retained work rather than only priority. The rule is conditional on a COPY having a set of legal outputs, not on a prediction that source pages are always dead.
what_is_old: No-fill/bypass for low-reuse translations, small victim/shadow caches, delayed placement from one translation level to another, explicit pinning and temporary mapping forwarding already exist.

Exact dynamic pin plus bypass using the same output sets and ownership events is an equivalent implementation of the proposed rule. It must receive the same information and can expose a cheaper implementation; equivalence is not proof that a publication already contained the whole COPY-choice contract.
Do not name a request-local physical address or PTE register a novel cache. It is a priced continuation for the immutable original request.
candidate.positive_research_hypothesis: If the choice-set contract lets a compact event-driven guard and direct original-request delivery improve the joint V/A or cost frontier against published admission/pinning methods and executable capacity/locality controls, and the closest prior designs do not cover that contract-driven preservation, the integrated mechanism can be a contribution. If same-cost ordinary set-aware pin+bypass reproduces all actions and benefits, do not assert an independently better replacement algorithm; use the cheaper implementation and retain the choice-contract system contribution only if its own evidence survives.

restricted_first_scope: Use the existing round03 pool-parent, source READ, immutable WRITE child and owned-buffer semantics. The ordinary fixed-destination COPY contract remains unchanged.

Fixed, pinned, single-stage 4KiB mappings and registered writeable pools with stable context/privilege. Count only tracked, matching, non-global 4KiB entries; normal WRITE permission checks still run.

For the simple local rule, each offer includes the entire same pool, and different pools have disjoint slot ownership/physical storage. Arbitrary descriptor subsets or overlapping pools require root's global choice-graph rule instead.

Initially aligned64B copies that produce one real source AR and one real destination AW with all8 beats; shorter configured burst limits must retain the endpoint obligation until every necessary per-page translation has actually been captured.
One optional delayed result cell for the main walker; native two pending translation lifecycles, eight AX heads and actual payload capacity are not expanded or treated as free preparation slots.

information: Actual IOTLB fill/replacement/invalidation events and the small round03 resident/free index.
Validated ownership FREE->COPY and consumer release, not unverified software timestamps or an early completion indication.
Number and pool identity of genuinely admitted unbound COPY parents, and the chosen slot after BIND.

Successful ordinary WRITE translation response accepted into the stable physical request header. AW VALID by itself is not an unaccepted permission and cannot discharge a still-unresolved translation obligation.
native_missing_interfaces: The main walk currently succeeds via shared IOTLB update followed by lookup/hit. A no-fill source result therefore needs an explicit permission-checked result mux/direct-delivery path; suppressing update alone would restart or hang the walk.
The legalizer/backend must identify pool-source requests and expose accepted destination translation/child readiness. No general retryable permission voucher or mutable published header is assumed.
Optional delayed cache insertion needs a return path from the parent phase event to the IOTLB and a priced cell. This is not already provided by decouple_aw or research observations.

local_rule.definitions: For pool p, U[p] is the admitted unbound parent count. H[p] is the number of DISTINCT slots that are currently FREE and have a tracked matching resident translation. K[p]=min(U[p],H[p]) is the capacity that this source fill must preserve; it preserves existing usable capacity and does not claim to create missing hits. B is the set of bound endpoints whose real normal WRITE translation has not yet been accepted.
local_rule.victim_test: For each way w in the owner's ordinary policy mask, compute H_after[p,w] after replacing that actual way with the source result. Duplicates are counted correctly: evicting one duplicate does not reduce H while another remains. A victim is allowed only if H_after[p,w]>=K[p] for all relevant disjoint pools and it does not remove the last tracked copy of an endpoint in B. Select ordinary masked PLRU among allowed victims. If none, direct-deliver the READ result without shared fill.
lookup_and_admission: On admission, increment U only after the actual completion/payload/free-capacity reservation succeeds. H may be zero; the guard then preserves zero and ordinary cold fallback remains legal.
On BIND, atomically consume a real FREE slot and the abstract credit, decrement U, and transfer protection from a FREE-choice obligation to a FIXED pending-WRITE obligation for the selected hot slot.

Do not remove protection merely because FREE->COPY made the selected slot disappear from H: filling a retained source at that instant could evict the selected target before its WRITE translation and recreate the exact walk being avoided.

Discharge the bound endpoint obligation only once its successful normal WRITE translation has been accepted into the immutable physical header. Every later needed child translation is separately accounted for; the first restricted one-AW design avoids assuming that a first child authorizes a whole4KiB page transfer.

Once a direct-delivered source result's original request has succeeded and the bound-WRITE obligation is discharged, an optional retained mapping can install into a now-expendable way under a fresh guard check. Installation is optional and can be discarded on conflict, timeout or invalidation.
pseudocode: verify normal READ/context/privilege exactly as on the hit path
if allowed != 0: fill(result, masked_plru(allowed)); ordinary result delivery
on_bind(parent,slot): atomic ownership/credit update; set bound_write_obligation(parent,slot)
on_accepted_write_translation(parent): clear that child obligation; try guarded_optional_install(parent_retained_result)
on_invalidation/config_clear: clear retained result and advisory references; do not alter an already-public AXI request
on_cell_timeout/conflict: discard retained cache opportunity, never delay permission or response draining

distinct_count_and_event_handling.duplicates: Two IOTLB rows for the same(pool,slot) contribute one H, while each is an actual replacement candidate. A unique representative can be the lowest valid row index; a 16-row implementation needs at most120 small pool/slot equality comparisons. Alternatively a per-pool64-slot presence bitmap costs256bits for four pools plus multi-reference bookkeeping; neither implementation is free.
distinct_count_and_event_handling.overlapping_parents_same_pool: If all parents may choose any slot in one shared pool, U counts them and H is distinct FREE slots, so H>=U is the necessary instantaneous matching capacity. Each actual BIND is atomic. A hot slot cannot satisfy two simultaneously owned outputs.
distinct_count_and_event_handling.overlapping_choice_sets: Local per-request H>=1 is insufficient: V={X,Y}, A={Y}, hot={X,Y}; evicting X leaves each request one choice but reduces simultaneous matching rank2->1. Root's matching-capacity mechanism is required for this case. Do not pretend independent per-pool counters solve arbitrary overlapping offers.
distinct_count_and_event_handling.same_edge_order: Construct from actual resolved next ownership and actual IOTLB next state. Invalidation has the native precedence over fill. Ownership reservations/releases are serialized and validated; a concurrent fill uses the resulting FREE state. Recompute unique references and H from the resolved rows, not independent increment/decrement guesses that lose duplicates or same-edge release.
distinct_count_and_event_handling.pipeline_or_drop: A pipelined index must either serialize a source-fill decision until its relevant events are current or conservatively treat uncertain rows as unprotected hints and record lost capacity. Dropping metadata keeps normal permissions/data correct, but invalidates any assertion that all useful resident choices were preserved. Lost hints and rebuild cost are negative test cases.
distinct_count_and_event_handling.permissions: The guard is a performance policy. Cached availability hints, pool ownership or retained source PTE content never authorize an unchosen WRITE, another SID, or a future request. Every endpoint has its own ordinary device/context/permission check.

fairness_failure_and_backpressure.no_walk_stall: A filled-source decision cannot wait indefinitely for output release or force a returned PTE/AXI R to remain blocked while hoping for a better victim. Direct result delivery must permit the real request to finish; optional deferred installation is discarded when its cell is busy.
fairness_failure_and_backpressure.soft_not_hard_reservation: These guards preserve useful existing choices, not a hard promise that all future writes hit. Invalidation, untracked fills, an urgent non-source request or a configured fairness override may remove a witness; the parent still chooses a real FREE output and runs a normal cold walk.
fairness_failure_and_backpressure.fairness_policy: Retain the existing SID policy masks and normal scheduling. Restrict the source no-fill rule to the admitted pool-parent source phase. Bound optional result age and outstanding cells. If a deployment needs a cache-entitlement override, use a stated finite per-SID bypass budget/age override and charge the resulting lost choices; do not claim universal residency guarantees together with forced fill. No request is denied normal permission service solely because it cannot populate the cache.
fairness_failure_and_backpressure.fault: Source denial produces no legal READ result or cached deferred permission. Destination denial follows normal error/drain/quarantine. The native NO_ERROR_HANDLING datapath does not prove that new faults are handled; downstream must add actual status aggregation and drain logic.
fairness_failure_and_backpressure.invalidation: Drop optional retained mappings on normal invalidation or pool epoch change. Keep all published VALID fields stable and legally complete already-issued transactions. First scope uses stable pinned mappings; full dynamic revocation/replay is neither implemented nor verified here.
fairness_failure_and_backpressure.completion: The round03 completion reservation and real final W/B rule remain. Freeing a translation obligation is different from freeing payload or marking the output consumer-ready.

hand_derivations.scope: Normalized arithmetic and legal semantic sketches only, not a model, native cycles or a verified native trace. M20 is assumed unhidden full endpoint walk cost and D24 includes two ordinary checks, real AR/R/AW/W/B and frontend cost for64B. Delta2 or4 must be replaced by actual paid timing.

single_copy_positive.setup: Two allocation ways contain hot destinations X and Y; X is FREE, Y is consumer-owned. Source S is cold; the fixed native victim is X. V's original pool COPY may use X or Y but Y is not yet FREE. No new output is released before binding.
single_copy_positive.ordinary_PLRU: S misses and evicts X; V must bind X and walk it: V=D+2M=64.
single_copy_positive.choice_guard: A legal rank-preserving victim Y exists if it has no fixed bound obligation; fill S into Y and bind X: V=D+M=44. If both cached entries are required by live obligations, no safe victim exists and direct delivery gives V=D+M+delta=46 atdelta2.
single_copy_positive.strong_control: Ordinary precise destination pin/victim selection reproduces44. If both entries are live, ordinary dynamic pin+bypass reproduces46. Therefore64->44/46 is a mechanism sanity check, not independent algorithm proof.
single_copy_positive.changed_work: The second endpoint walk is removed without eliminating either permission check or any real data transaction.

why_always_source_bypass_is_incomplete.setup: Same source S is reused in a second real COPY. Initially both output slots are FREE-hot, so a source fill can evict one while leaving a surviving output. The first output is actually consumed/released before the second operation. Warm histories and release CPU work are common.
why_always_source_bypass_is_incomplete.source_always_bypass: Two actual source walks: total two-copy work2D+2M=88 before additional bypass cost.
why_always_source_bypass_is_incomplete.safe_source_admit: Admit S while one hot output remains; its second use hits:2D+M=68 plus paid selection overhead.
why_always_source_bypass_is_incomplete.strong_control: Precise pin of one ordinary output plus source admission matches68. A reuse-aware ordinary bypass policy may also match. This distinguishes phase/choice-aware admission from unconditional source bypass, not from every strong admission policy.

optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.setup: Original workload has three real64B copies in legal phase order V1:S->X, A:Y->T, V2:S->Y. X/Y start cached in a two-way V allocation region; X FREE, Y held by A's consumer until its actual A read/use and release. T is a common cached A endpoint. Both X/Y translations must survive until V1's X WRITE and A's Y READ, while S will be reused. Announcing the A future obligation, any phase gate, source-result callback and metadata storage are explicitly paid new interfaces; this is not claimed native reachable yet.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.conventional_pin_X_and_admit_S: V1 walks S and evicts Y; A walks Y; V2 hits: total3D+2M=112.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.always_bypass_S: V1 source walk, A hits Y, V2 source walk: total112.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.defer_source_install_until_X_permission_: V1 walks S and direct-delivers; X WRITE translation hits. After that real accepted endpoint translation, X may be replaced by retained S. A hits Y, V2 hits S and Y. At total paid delta4:3D+M+delta=96; one actual walk rather than two.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.joint_metric: All3 copies move192 useful bytes. Serial work112->96 gives16.67% more useful-byte throughput under these assumptions. It does not establish a concurrent V/A Pareto win, fairness improvement or native speedup.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.neighbor: If S is never reused, retaining/installing it only adds cost; if Y's fixed use is absent, pin-X can fill S into Y immediately and win; if the delayed result is invalidated or its only cell is occupied, discard it and lose the future reuse saving; if one ordinary extra IOTLB entry fits the full budget, three entries reproduce92 and beat96.
optional_retirement_placement_hypothesis.decisive_control: A generic one-entry victim/shadow cache or source prepare/forward with phase-aware deferred install can reproduce the one-walk schedule. Price their actual keys, ports, routing and source/destination continuation equally. This is a possible compact integration/cost advantage, not a proven new caching algorithm.

hand_derivations.data_accounting: The three-copy example has6 successful endpoint permission checks,3 real AR,24 R beats,3 AW,24 W beats and3 B plus common descriptors/completions/releases. It never replaces actual data transfer with a synthetic preparation.

complete_control_set: Exact current-victim selection and destination pin until accepted normal WRITE translation; retain existing native concurrency and valid request stability.
Unconditional source bypass; source/destination-role bypass; a reuse-history dpPred-style predictor adapted to SID/VPN with its correct buffer/cost; MASK token/bypass admission.

Dynamic entry pin+bypass given the same registered pools, FREE events, pending endpoint identities and guard budget. Treat exact equivalence as a lower-cost implementation test, not an invented claim of published coverage.

Generic ordinary one-entry victim/cache or two-entry shadow cache with all native tag/context/attribute bits, comparators and lookup timing; it may be cheaper or faster than the delayed-placement path.
All necessary permissions prepared plus retention; source preparation with an efficient continuation; one-page write lookahead. No forced duplicate source walk or ignored allowed overlap.

Same complete area/port/data-buffer budget allocated to more ordinary IOTLB capacity, legal mask repartition, outstanding credits or hugepage/page-local pool layout. The tiny two-way examples do not establish a win over an extra entry.
L-F ordinary late allocation with no source-fill guard; L-F with event index only; local count guard; root global matching-capacity guard; optional deferred source install as separate ablation.

cost_reference.common_not_free: The entire round03 pool, ownership, event index, immutable parent, result routing, source payload, kernel generation/cache synchronization and completion costs remain. Do not quote the incremental fields as the entire mechanism area.
cost_reference.robust_one_stage_delayed_cell: PPN44+attributes8+VPN29+PSCID20+GSCID16+stages2+pool2+frontend2+epoch32+valid1+FSM2=158bits. Source PTE content is not a general permission token. One cell does not mean one per each of four DMA engines.
cost_reference.possible_field_reuse: If one immutable parent per frontend and its registered source context/VPN/epoch remain available until optional insertion or discard, the cell could reference those existing fields and store content52+valid1+FSM2+pool2+frontend2=59bits. This requires a concrete lifetime and path proof; use158 until proved. Late insertion must not reuse another parent's metadata after job retirement.
cost_reference.local_guard_named_state: For four disjoint pools and16 IOTLB rows: unique-representative flags16; cached distinct counts4*5=20; pending bound-write bits4; source-policy flags4; age timer8; RR2; busy/valid state already in cell. With the robust158bit cell, subtotal212bits=27bytes after rounding. Extra event skid/pipeline records, semantic target tags, full route and MMIO are not in this subtotal.
logic_ports: Up to120 pool/slot equality tests to de-duplicate16 rows, four popcounts, victim impact tests over actual allocation mask, and a masked PLRU reducer.
For four bound parents, up to64 parent-slot/reference comparisons unless fields are encoded into the existing index; exact pipeline cost must be charged.
Permission-checked PTW-result mux into normal result path, stable owner association, optional deferred-fill arbitration, invalidation/config priority and same-edge lookup/install handling.
No added CAM lookup port for the one parent-indexed cell is assumed; no generic lookup reuse from it by later requests. The later reuse only occurs after a real guarded IOTLB installation.
Read payload remains charged; optional mapping retention cannot reserve an unbounded number of source grants or block normal walker progress.
cost_reference.extra_requests: Direct no-fill delivery adds no synthetic READ, WRITE or PTW. Optional cache install adds an update-port event and can stall/evict ordinary work. Future-liveness announcement, pool registration, releases and callbacks cost software/bus actions and storage. Full system cost may favor ordinary pin+bypass or larger capacity.

direct_source_evidence.fact: PTW/MSI update mux supplies the IOTLB, and PT completes from iotlb_lu_hit with normal permissions. No result delivery from a suppressed source update exists in this path. Add a real result path rather than just disable update.

Actual update installs tags/content under replace_en; allocation_mask is policy_mask and replacement follows masked tree-PLRU. A new guard must act on the actual victim selector and preserve normal touch/invalidation behavior.
Stage content contains PPN and separate size/permission bits, and update carries VPN/PSCID/GSCID. These are real result storage fields, not a one-bit success assumption.

primary_sources.title: MASK: Redesigning the GPU Memory Hierarchy to Support Multi-Application Concurrency
primary_sources.review_scope: Direct original PDF section5.2, pages6-7 and introduction mechanism overview.
primary_sources.coverage: Token-owning warps fill shared L2 TLB; other warps use a small associative bypass cache. Bypass and selective admission are published actions. The reviewed section does not specify a FREE-owned interchangeable COPY output set or matching-capacity contract.
primary_sources.judgment: Because MASK covers shared-TLB fill bypass and a separate translation holding cache, those actions alone cannot be claimed independently new.

primary_sources.title: Dead Page and Dead Block Predictors: Cleaning TLBs and Caches Together
primary_sources.review_scope: Direct author PDF introduction/sectionIII and fill/bypass discussion, pages1-3.
primary_sources.coverage: PC/VPN reuse history predicts dead-on-arrival translations and bypasses their shared last-level placement. A small shadow/victim table detects misprediction. The paper also considers filling L1 first and inserting into LLT on L1 eviction. Its stream is fixed; the reviewed mechanism does not choose a different future DMA endpoint from actual FREE ownership.
primary_sources.judgment: Because this prior work covers no-fill one-use translation and delayed inter-level insertion, semantic last-use, temporary result storage and fill deferral alone do not establish an independent contribution.

primary_sources.title: Dead on Arrival: Characterizing and Protecting Against Dead-Entry TLB Misses in GPU Microarchitectures
primary_sources.venue_year: 2026-06 preprint; submission status, not verified accepted venue
primary_sources.review_scope: Original v2 PDF background, related work and section6, pages2-4,7-8.
primary_sources.coverage: DEPOT records recent eviction history and protects reinstalled entries with timed replacement preference; normal fallback remains. Its GPU miss handling includes same-VPN MSHR merge and direct propagation to waiting requests. It does not turn a FREE pool-output choice set into a cache-admission obligation in the reviewed sections.
primary_sources.judgment: Because recent-eviction protection and merged-walk result forwarding are covered, those actions do not establish the proposed choice-contract contribution.

primary_sources.title: Compiler-assisted and DMA-related shared-TLB prefetch/locking study
primary_sources.venue_year: 2018 preprint; use original map title/venue after exact bibliographic check
primary_sources.review_scope: Original PDF sectionIV-A2 and TLB miss handling/lock discussion, pages4-6.
primary_sources.coverage: Explicit prefetch requests, software progress windows and TLB locks already provide preparation and retention. It motivates a real strong prepare+pin control. Exact title not revalidated for this artifact, so this is a mechanism lead rather than a new asserted citation.

primary_sources.title: Trail: Scalable and Low-Cost Temporal TLB Prefetching via Page-Table-Embedded Deltas
primary_sources.review_scope: Original PDF obtained; abstract/intro only. Not a complete closest-mechanism review.
primary_sources.coverage: Stores temporal deltas in leaf-PTE metadata for later walk-triggered prefetch. It is an additional current-map lead; its availability or absence of keywords does not prove newness of this admission rule.

downstream_minimal_discriminators: Reuse root F1 legal traces and source/selected-WRITE callback contract. Show that the source no-fill route completes an actual immutable request rather than requiring the missing shared fill hit.

From identical original workloads compare index-only L-F, exact victim/pin, unconditional source bypass, dpPred-style policy, local distinct-capacity rule and root rank rule. Use the overlap {X,Y}/{Y} case to separate local counts from global capacity.

A single optional deferred-cell three-copy trace tests whether phase-directed insertion saves one real walk; include generic victim cache, efficient prepare and extra-entry controls with exact costs. Stop any separate placement-algorithm claim if they match at equal/lower full cost.

Adjacent traces: source reused/not reused; no hot FREE choices; duplicate IOTLB rows; output bind before actual WRITE permission; one invalidation; retained cell occupied; actual consumer release after the useful window.

final_design_judgments.rule_newness: Only the COPY-choice/actual-ownership admission contract remains a concrete candidate for a new integrated capability. Published bypass, dead-page detection, pinning and deferred fill are explicitly excluded as independent claims.
final_design_judgments.unique_system_benefit: Not established by these hand examples. They identify work that can be removed and strong equal-action controls. A paid native trace and cost frontier are the next evidence; no repeated broad model or compilation is justified here.
final_design_judgments.implementation_feasibility: A restricted one-source/no-fill path plus existing pool-parent is technically plausible, but requires a real permission/result route and binding-to-WRITE obligation handoff. The current source was directly read and does not implement these interfaces.
final_design_judgments.root_integration: Root's preservation of maximum matching rank handles arbitrary overlapping candidate sets; this local k rule supplies the simpler disjoint-pool limit, duplicate/event contracts, ordinary pin+bypass baseline and optional phase-placement hypothesis.
